paragraphs: When finance teams struggle to integrate AI into NetSuite, I’ve built containerised agents that run on serverless infrastructure, ensuring secure, scalable automation.
I deployed the agent as a Docker container on AWS Lambda (Lambda Web Adapter) with ECR image pipelines, IAM execution roles and least‑privilege policies.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python (FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI) for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client, presented in a live stakeholder demo.
I have not used Azure yet.
Could we schedule a brief call so I can walk you through how my serverless agent deployments could streamline your NetSuite workflows?
